subject.title: fix(docs): make check:docs work in native PowerShell on Windows

question: Should this docs-fix PR own the Windows command-budget repair, or should it be narrowed while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91610 owns the budget and smoke-coverage path?
rationale: The PR title claims the native PowerShell docs-check fix, but the branch leaves the command-budget path unchanged and overlaps the companion Windows smoke/budget PR.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR as the docs-check fix only if it preserves LF drift detection, handles the Windows command-budget path, and includes native PowerShell proof.

options.title: Split the overlap
options.body: Narrow or close this branch and let the companion Windows smoke/budget PR own the remaining native PowerShell command-limit work.

options.title: Accept weaker automation
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally accept hidden CRLF drift and no Windows proof, but that weakens docs validation for contributors.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the docs-check fix only if it preserves LF drift detection, handles the Windows command-budget path, and includes native PowerShell proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent overlap across the merged PowerShell-safe formatter and Windows command-shim path.
